result.eventDescription: Charged when a city page is fetched and the row is ok. Robots skips, missing pages, and errors are saved and not billed.

proxy.eventDescription: Charged when a page is retried through Apify Proxy after a direct request is blocked. Direct requests are free. A robots disallow is not retried.

captcha.eventDescription: Charged only when a solver returns a token after the proxy retry is still a challenge. A disabled or unconfigured solve is not billed.
